events.title: Ai2 opens AstaBrief-8B for fast cited research reports
events.title_zh: Ai2 开源快速生成引文报告的 AstaBrief-8B
events.summary: Ai2 released AstaBrief-8B, an Apache-2.0 model that turns a research question plus retrieved scientific excerpts into a cited report in one pass. It starts from Qwen3-8B, uses supervised fine-tuning and offline DPO, and ships with weights, training datasets and a local PDF example. On the 100-question ScholarQA-CS2 test set, Ai2 reports stronger answer-and-citation scores than its SFT checkpoint and similar aggregate quality to slower multi-step systems.
events.why_it_matters: For teams building literature assistants, AstaBrief offers a small, inspectable alternative to multi-step proprietary report pipelines. The reported gains come from Ai2's own retrieval and evaluation setup, so test citation entailment and omitted evidence on your corpus before adoption.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 AstaBrief-8B。这个 Apache-2.0 模型一次生成带引文的研究报告，输入是研究问题和已检索的论文片段。模型基于 Qwen3-8B，经监督微调和离线 DPO 训练；权重、训练数据与本地 PDF 示例均已公开。Ai2 在 100 题 ScholarQA-CS2 测试集上报告，它的答案与引文综合分高于 SFT checkpoint，并接近更慢的多步系统。
events.summary_en: Ai2 released AstaBrief-8B, an Apache-2.0 model that turns a research question plus retrieved scientific excerpts into a cited report in one pass. It starts from Qwen3-8B, uses supervised fine-tuning and offline DPO, and ships with weights, training datasets and a local PDF example. On the 100-question ScholarQA-CS2 test set, Ai2 reports stronger answer-and-citation scores than its SFT checkpoint and similar aggregate quality to slower multi-step systems.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做文献助手的团队来说，AstaBrief 提供了一个小型、可检查的替代方案，不必完全依赖多步闭源报告流水线。现有结果来自 Ai2 自己的检索与评测环境，上线前要用自有语料检查引文是否真的支持结论，以及关键证据是否被漏掉。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams building literature assistants, AstaBrief offers a small, inspectable alternative to multi-step proprietary report pipelines. The reported gains come from Ai2's own retrieval and evaluation setup, so test citation entailment and omitted evidence on your corpus before adoption.

technical_details.training: SFT followed by offline DPO; DPO trained on 8 H100 GPUs
technical_details.data: 39.5K filtered SFT examples and about 6K preference pairs reported by Ai2
technical_details.evaluation: ScholarQA-CS2 test average 87.0; citation precision 90.5 and citation recall 78.2, author-reported
technical_details.availability: Ungated weights, training datasets and local report-generation example

technical_details_zh.训练: 先 SFT，再做离线 DPO；DPO 使用 8 张 H100
technical_details_zh.数据: Ai2 报告 3.95 万条筛选后的 SFT 样本与约 6000 对偏好数据
technical_details_zh.评测: ScholarQA-CS2 测试集综合分 87.0；引文精确率 90.5、召回率 78.2，均为作者报告
technical_details_zh.可用性: 无门禁权重、训练数据集与本地报告生成示例

events.next_action_zh: 用 20 个自有研究问题比较引文支持率、关键证据遗漏和单份报告延迟。
events.next_action_en: Compare citation support, missed key evidence and report latency on 20 internal research questions.

evidence.claim_zh: AstaBrief-8B 的权重、训练数据与本地示例已公开；Ai2 报告它在 ScholarQA-CS2 上改善引文质量。
evidence.claim_en: AstaBrief-8B ships open weights, training data and a local example; Ai2 reports improved citation quality on ScholarQA-CS2.

changes.summary_zh: Ai2 开源快速生成引文报告的 AstaBrief-8B
changes.summary_en: Ai2 opens AstaBrief-8B for fast cited research reports

events.title: DeepSeek opens a plugin-first desktop agent harness
events.title_zh: DeepSeek 开源插件优先的桌面 agent harness
events.summary: DeepSeek released DeepSeek Harness in worldwide public preview for macOS, Windows and a local web UI. The MIT-licensed project uses an everything-is-a-plugin architecture for everyday work, coding, research and background tasks. Agent teams, auto-approval review, scheduled tasks and voice input are still marked experimental, and the repository warns of compatibility-breaking changes.
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating local agent runtimes, DeepSeek Harness is a fully inspectable desktop and web option with a public plugin architecture. Its developer-preview stability and experimental approval features require isolation before serious work.
events.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness 进入全球公开预览，提供 macOS、Windows 与本地 Web UI。这个 MIT 开源项目采用“一切皆插件”架构，可处理日常办公、编码、研究和后台任务。Agent teams、自动审批复核、定时任务与语音输入仍标为实验性，仓库也明确警告会有破坏性兼容变化。
events.summary_en: DeepSeek released DeepSeek Harness in worldwide public preview for macOS, Windows and a local web UI. The MIT-licensed project uses an everything-is-a-plugin architecture for everyday work, coding, research and background tasks. Agent teams, auto-approval review, scheduled tasks and voice input are still marked experimental, and the repository warns of compatibility-breaking changes.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估本地 agent 运行时的团队来说，DeepSeek Harness 提供了可检查的桌面与 Web 方案，还有公开插件架构。开发者预览的稳定性和实验性审批能力意味着只能先在隔离环境试用。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams evaluating local agent runtimes, DeepSeek Harness is a fully inspectable desktop and web option with a public plugin architecture. Its developer-preview stability and experimental approval features require isolation before serious work.

technical_details.availability: worldwide public preview; macOS, Windows and local web UI
technical_details.experimental: agent teams, auto-approval review, scheduled tasks and voice input
technical_details.stability: developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes expected

technical_details_zh.可用性: 全球公开预览；macOS、Windows 与本地 Web UI
technical_details_zh.架构: 基于 Cordis 的一切皆插件
technical_details_zh.实验功能: agent teams、自动审批复核、定时任务与语音输入

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在一次性账户和隔离目录中安装，测试插件权限、自动审批、失败恢复与数据外发。
events.next_action_en: Install it with a disposable account and isolated directory for one day; test plugin permissions, auto-approval, recovery and data egress.

evidence.claim_zh: DeepSeek Harness 已全球公开预览并以 MIT 开源，桌面安装包和本地 Web UI 均可用。
evidence.claim_en: DeepSeek Harness is in worldwide public preview under MIT, with desktop downloads and a local web UI.

changes.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness enters worldwide public preview and opens its code
